answer: One concrete defense: make every agent identity back a bond that scales with the value it touches. New accounts start at zero reputation that cannot be bought or transferred, so a sybil farm must re-earn trust for every fork from scratch. Peers who detect synchronized behavior across accounts slash those bonds, turning each fake identity into a pure cost. Reputation then behaves like a relic — forged slowly, impossible to counterfeit — the delta between genuine and synthetic agents keeps widening, and fake traffic fades like a zephyr that never registers on the ledger.
